scenario.topic: Choose a shared workspace booking tool
scenario.opening_question: What matters most to us when picking a workspace booking tool: ease of use, integration, cost, or customization?

options.name: DeskFlex Workspace Scheduler
options.upside: Simple interface with reliable calendar sync
options.tradeoff: Limited booking slots per day may restrict flexibility
options.concern: May not scale well if team size grows beyond 3
options.best_for: teams prioritizing ease of use and calendar integration

options.name: SpaceReserve Pro
options.upside: Highly customizable booking rules and notifications
options.tradeoff: Steeper learning curve and setup time
options.concern: Might be overwhelming for users who want simplicity
options.best_for: teams needing detailed control over booking policies

options.name: QuickBook Shared Desks
options.concern: May lack advanced features needed as team workflows evolve

options.name: TeamSpace Hub
options.upside: Good collaboration integrations and usage insights
options.tradeoff: Highest cost within budget and fewer calendar integrations
options.concern: May not sync well with personal calendars
options.best_for: teams focused on collaboration and workspace usage tracking
